user.title: Connect a Mannito board
user.description: In the Mannito cloud, open your board and create an API token in the "API-Zugänge" (API access) card. Each token works for one board only.

data_description.url: Address of the Mannito cloud. Keep the suggested address unless you run a cloud of your own.
data_description.api_token: Starts with mnt_. Its rights (Read, Control, Configure) decide which entities and controls you get.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The token of {name} no longer works (revoked or expired). Create a new token for this board in the Mannito cloud.

data_description.api_token: Starts with mnt_. Its rights (Read, Control, Configure) decide which entities and controls you get.

reconfigure.title: Change cloud address or token
reconfigure.description: The token must belong to the same board. A new token replaces the old one, which is then revoked in the Mannito cloud.

data_description.url: Address of the Mannito cloud. Keep the suggested address unless you run a cloud of your own.
data_description.api_token: Starts with mnt_. Its rights (Read, Control, Configure) decide which entities and controls you get.

error.invalid_auth: The token is unknown, revoked or expired.

abort.already_configured: This board is already set up.
abort.wrong_board: The token belongs to another board.

options.set_co2: Turn CO₂ dosing on or off

open_valve.name: Open valve
open_valve.description: Opens a valve for up to 60 seconds. It closes on its own.

run_valves.name: Run valves of a grow area
run_valves.description: Opens the valves of a grow area one after another, after the pump has run its lead time. Give seconds to measure the flow, or ml per pot for a test shot. Each valve opens for 60 seconds at most.

area.name: Grow area
area.description: The grow area (device) whose valves open.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Each valve stays open this long (1-60).

record_measurement.name: Record measurement
record_measurement.description: Records a measurement of a plant, such as its height. Pick a grow area with a single planting to record it for all of its plants.

target.name: Plant
target.description: The plant (device), or a grow area with a single planting.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value in the unit of the measurement (height in cm).

record_note.name: Record observation
record_note.description: Records an observation on a plant. Marked as a problem, it stays open until you resolve it in the Mannito cloud.

target.name: Plant
target.description: The plant (device), or a grow area with a single planting.

problem.name: Problem
problem.description: Stays open until it is resolved.

tank_entry.name: Tank entry
tank_entry.description: Logs a tank event for a grow area: mixed fresh, topped up, drawn off or level checked. The cloud calculates the tank level from these entries.

area.name: Grow area
area.description: The grow area that draws from the tank.

kind.name: What happened
kind.description: Mixed fresh, topped up, drawn off or level checked.

liters.name: Liters
liters.description: Liters, as named in the choice above.

tank_reading.name: Tank reading
tank_reading.description: Records EC, pH or temperature measured in the tank of a grow area.

area.name: Grow area
area.description: The grow area that draws from the tank.

grow_cycle_action.name: Grow cycle action
grow_cycle_action.description: Changes the running grow cycle of a grow area.

area.name: Grow area
area.description: The grow area (device) whose valves open.

use_co2.name: Dose CO₂
use_co2.description: On to dose CO₂, off to stop.
